title: Tilt sensitivity swapping
summary: The player changes sensitivity reactively during matches or right after mistakes, shifting focus away from gameplay and toward whether the setup feels wrong.
telltales: Sensitivity is changed right after dying, missing, or tilting
The player spends more attention on whether the sens feels off than on the game state
contraindications: Do not forbid all sensitivity experimentation during training
avoid: Using mid-match sens swaps as a substitute for concentrated practice on the real weakness
